title: FOLDED CONTROLS STAY CLEAR
why: The quality comparison critic found a ghost panel under the bot list. After the controls folded, their hint still used the open compact panel shift and zoom.
now: The folded f1 controls hint uses its screen anchor and keeps its drag offset. The open controls lists keep their existing placement and timing.

edits.anchor: drawLegend(G.legendOn===2?_fz:1);   // v20.74 (H40): the full list is told its zoom
edits.replacement: drawLegend(G.legendOn===2&&!HOL.c?_fz:1); // v28.xx (cw-cx-foldedhint): the full-list fit scale belongs only to the open full list.

if(!G.legendOn){
    ctx.font=uiFont('label',Math.max(1,uiScale())); ctx.fillStyle=UIC.tx_2; // v28.xx (cw-cx-foldedhint): at least 16px now that the hint no longer borrows the compact-panel zoom.
